title: Ginger Lemon Freezer Cake
description: Layers of ginger nut biscuits and lemon cream, frozen overnight. The biscuits turn soft and cake-like, giving this dessert the consistency of a frozen sponge.

ingredients.text: 280g ginger nut biscuits (roughly a whole packet)

steps: Line a 23cm round cake tin with cling film, covering the base and sides with about 2.5cm overhang.
Whip the cream to soft peaks (3 minutes with electric whisk). Add 2 dessert spoons of lemon curd and whisk to combine.
Lay one layer of ginger biscuits over the bottom of the tin (8 per layer — one in the middle, seven in a circle). Spoon a third of the cream on top and spread to cover.
Repeat with two more layers of biscuit and cream, leaving 4 biscuits to crumble on top.
Microwave the remaining lemon curd for 10–15 seconds, pour over the top in a zigzag pattern. Crush the leftover biscuits and scatter over.
Freeze for at least 4 hours or overnight. Take out 20 minutes before serving.
notes: Serves 8–10. Can keep in the freezer for up to 3 months.
